sentences.text: Games currently cannot be shown live between 2:45pm and 5:15pm on a Saturday The first tentative steps to end the 3pm television blackout have been taken by Scottish football as it seeks offers for the next broadcast cycle.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: The SPFL has said that it is "flexible about the number of games" that will form part of the new deal, which will kick in from the 2029-30 season.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: BBC Sport understands this includes the possibility that broadcasters could bid to show all matches live - including those shown on a Saturday afternoon.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: The SPFL has created a tender with the greatest flexibility on the basis that the broadcaster does not seek to impose Article 48 of the Uefa Statutes.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: Article 48 allows leagues to set specific times when matches are banned from being shown live on television.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: It can only be enforced when 50% of matches in a country's top two divisions are played at the same time.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: While other parts of Europe have experimented with a blackout, it is now only present in the UK between 2:45pm and 5:15pm on a Saturday.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: Other leagues now tend to stagger kick-off times so the top divisions do not all play at the same time, meaning the blackout could not be applied.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: In the UK, 3pm remains the traditional, default kick-off time for all leagues from the very top down through non-league.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: It was introduced due to fears that televised games at 3pm could affect attendances, not just at the clubs involved but at those down the divisions too.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: But as streaming has grown in popularity, critics have argued that it hinders the ability of clubs to exploit this revenue stream.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: This is especially the case in the lower levels, which have had to adhere to the blackout and not show any of their games online.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: The Cymru Premier, the top division of football in Wales which has a mixture of professional and semi-professional clubs, removed the blackout in the summer in favour of a streaming model for all matches.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.text: In August, Premier League chief executive Richard Masters indicated the direction of travel was to end the blackout, but any decision would be 18 months away and taken in consultation with the EFL and the FA.
sentences.article_title: Scottish football could pave way for 3pm TV blackout to end

sentences.article_title: Australian sunscreen brands face stricter rules after safety scandal

sentences.article_title: Australian sunscreen brands face stricter rules after safety scandal

sentences.text: "Australians expect the SPF on the label to be backed by robust evidence," she said in a statement over email.
sentences.article_title: Australian sunscreen brands face stricter rules after safety scandal

sentences.article_title: Australian sunscreen brands face stricter rules after safety scandal

sentences.text: Suppliers would also be required to provide their SPF testing data to the TGA when they list a sunscreen, and keep periodically testing the product throughout its shelf life.
sentences.article_title: Australian sunscreen brands face stricter rules after safety scandal

sentences.article_title: China's families are now supporting more old people than kids

sentences.article_title: China's families are now supporting more old people than kids

sentences.text: US Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr. has released plans to loosen restrictions on controversial peptides.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: The plans, which were announced in the US Federal Register on Wednesday, say Kennedy would allow compounding pharmacies to prepare six popular peptides, which have not been approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: In an unusual move, the draft came from the office of the health secretary rather than the FDA.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: After the plan has been officially published later this week, there will be a two-week public comment period.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Unregulated injectable peptides have become popular online.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Experts have warned of their lack of clinical trials for humans and unknown long-term effects.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: US health panel loosens restrictions for controversial peptides popular online The peptides mentioned in the plan include BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, MOTS-c and Semax.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Compounding pharmacies will be able to mix them to create medications.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: The BBC has contacted the FDA for comment.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: An FDA advisory panel voted in July to loosen restrictions on the six peptides.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: But FDA staff members recommended against it.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Kennedy has described himself as a "big fan" of the drugs and has previously vowed to ease restrictions on them after the Biden administration clamped down on the growing industry.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Peptides are short chains of amino acids, or small proteins, which our bodies naturally produce.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: They act as messengers, telling cells what to do, and play vital roles in skin health, immune system and hormone regulation.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Peptides have been used to treat medical conditions for more than a century.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Insulin, one of the first peptide hormones to be discovered, helps people with Type 1 diabetes and some with Type 2 manage their blood sugar levels.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: But now unregulated peptides have exploded onto the wellness market since GLP-1s, weight loss drugs, became mainstream.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Online influencers have been marketing peptides in what they have called "stacks" for unproven uses, claiming they can be used as a quick way to help people look younger, heal or improve their skin.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: They have become popular among teens on TikTok, especially boys, over unproven claims they help to build muscle, part of online trends known as "biohacking" and "looksmaxxing".
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Health experts have cautioned against use of the drugs, citing a lack of clinical trials for humans and the unknown long-term effects of the substances.
sentences.article_title: US Health Secretary RFK Jr to expand access to unapproved peptides

sentences.text: Jalen Hurts has led the Philadelphia Eagles to two Super Bowls, winning the NFL's championship game in 2025 News that Jalen Hurts played a game hours after being diagnosed with a blood clot had already shocked the NFL world.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: The Philadelphia Eagles then said their star quarterback will probably miss the rest of the season after multiple blood clots were found in his lungs - a life-threatening condition if not treated quickly.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: It raised questions over the NFL's handling of the matter and its general approach to player health and safety, partly because the game in question was part of the league's international series.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: What do we know about what happened?
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Why was Hurts allowed to play and then fly home straight after?
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Sunday, 4 October: Another player stepped on Hurts' left calf during Philadelphia's defeat by the Los Angeles Rams, although he completed the game.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Thursday, 8 October: Hurts first reported an issue to the team.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: He trained in full all week and had treatment on Thursday and Friday.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Saturday, 10 October: The Eagles arrived in London in the morning and Hurts visited the Cleveland Clinic that evening.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: An ultrasound showed he had a superficial blood clot (vein thrombosis) in his calf but he was cleared to play on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Sunday, 11 October: Hurts returned to the team hotel at about 3am before playing the full game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: A follow-up ultrasound was recommended within 72 hours and Hurts was cleared for the flight home.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Wednesday, 14 October: After receiving daily treatment, Hurts had another ultrasound, which showed the clot had moved, and he was ruled out of the next game.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Monday, 19 October: Joint statement by the Eagles and Hurts' agent said further tests showed he now has deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli (multiple blood clots in both lungs).
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: His treatment will involve blood-thinning medicine and he should make a full recovery but is expected to miss the rest of the season.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Dr Allen Sills, the NFL's chief medical officer, was in London that weekend and arranged for Hurts to be evaluated at the Cleveland Clinic, an American-owned private hospital which is an official supplier of sports medicine services for the NFL's London games.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: The NFL has protocols in place for concussions, emergency preparedness and extreme heat, for games in the US and overseas.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: But, speaking at a news conference last Tuesday, Sills explained the league does not have a protocol for situations such as this.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Nevertheless, Sills said that those who dealt with Hurts were "incredibly conservative" and that he had "complete confidence" in how the Eagles handled the situation.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Later that day, the NFL Players Association (NFLPA) called for a full investigation, adding that the NFL "previously informed the union that it did not plan to review the care [Hurts] received".

sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: Medical advice on whether to sleep and/or stay active is decided case by case.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: "It's not as simple as some people think," said Dr Mihic.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL

sentences.text: "There's an amount of judgement that goes into this.

sentences.text: It's like you're stuck between a rock and a hard place, but then you make your call." As he and the NFL finalise their medical preparations for the Madrid game, Dr Mihic expects them to discuss scenarios such as that involving Hurts.
sentences.article_title: Why Jalen Hurts played with blood clot and what it means for NFL
